name: perse-cua-workspace
description: Build workspace for perse-cua — an out-of-tree DSH plugin of Persevere with DSH. The installable package lives in packages/perse-cua.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && node scripts/generate-remote.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs && node scripts/build-presenter.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm pack --workspace perse-cua
scripts.test:preview-bench: node scripts/generate-remote.mjs && node --test test/preview-bench.test.mjs test/preview-client.test.mjs test/client-dismiss.test.mjs
